label: ktx2-research-cycle
context: Researched KTX2/Basis Universal texture compression for SOMA mobile. Key findings: Use KTX2 (not raw .basis) with Basis Universal transcoder. ETC1S for diffuse (smallest), UASTC for normals (quality). 6-8x VRAM reduction vs PNG. gltf-transform CLI handles both Draco geometry + KTX2 texture compression in one pipeline. Combined with Draco: 50MB anatomy GLB → 3-5MB download, 8-12MB VRAM. Next cycle: research Meshopt vs Draco for mobile decode speed OR research WebGPU compute shaders for medical volume rendering OR begin LODManager.ts implementation.
